snips.title: Report a problem with a streetlight | SF.gov
snips.excerpt: Report a streetlight that is out, flickering or damaged. The San Francisco Public Utilities Commission maintains most city streetlights and SF 311 routes the request.

snips.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
snips.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.

value.draft_subject: [PIN-x] Streetlight out at Valencia St and 18th St
value.draft_body:
Hello,

A neighbor reported that a streetlight is out at Valencia St and 18th St in San Francisco. The crosswalk is very dark at night, which is a safety concern for people walking.

Could you confirm the service request and the expected repair window?

Thank you.
